issues.on_page: Sales 859,035 (Electric, Water, Sewer, Garbage enterprise funds)
issues.issue: [fixed 2026-10-28: category set to Utility Charges, detail_category other utility charges, fund field added] Enterprise utility sales belong in the user's Utility Charges category (CLAUDE.md 2026-10-28: utility fund sales/charges incl. garbage), not charges for services/fees. The line has no fund field, so user_rules.py's utility-fund rule will not catch it.

[fixed 2026-10-28: relabelled Capital Outlay: Streets/Highways, printed_label kept] Capital outlay line not relabelled 'Capital Outlay: Streets/Highways' (printed text in printed_label) as the user's capital-outlay rule requires; the Community Center line detail[30] was relabelled. disbursements[4] (64,050 = Community Center 52,000 + Street 12,050) mixes two functions, so it is left as printed.
